newsitem.title: HONG KONG: HK to waive double tax on airline income.
newsitem.headline: HK to waive double tax on airline income.

text.p: Hong Kong has reached separate agreements with New Zealand and Canada to waive double taxation on airline incomes, the government said on Wednesday.

Under the agreements, Hong Kong would only tax income generated from international traffic of Hong Kong airlines derived from New Zealand and Canada if they have been granted full tax relief by the two countries respectively, it said.
In return, Hong Kong would forgo tax rights to income of New Zealand and Canadian airlines derived from Hong Kong if such income is already subject to tax in their respective countries.
The orders would be gazetted on September 27 and tabled before Hong Kong's legislative council on October 2.
The first of such arrangements, negotiated on a case-by-case basis, was made with South Korea earlier in 1996, it said.
